name: dtech-website
description: D-TECH Solution Integrators static website — build tooling (minify CSS/JS). nodemailer is the only runtime dependency (SMTP for the api/ functions).

scripts.build:css: npm run build:tailwind && for f in assets/skin.css assets/tailwind.css assets/polish.css assets/jiva.css assets/color.css assets/skin-dark.css assets/prezi.css assets/fonts.css assets/case-studies.css assets/refresh.css assets/home.css assets/sections.css assets/light-chrome.css assets/events.css; do npx -y clean-css-cli -o "${f%.css}.min.css" "$f"; done && for f in assets/skin.min.css assets/color.min.css assets/polish.min.css assets/tailwind.min.css; do cat "$f"; echo; done > assets/bundle.min.css && npx -y purgecss --config purgecss.config.js && cp /tmp/purged/bundle.min.css assets/bundle.min.css
scripts.build:js: for f in assets/lucide.js assets/agent-a.js assets/refined.js assets/events.js; do npx -y terser "$f" -c -m -o "${f%.js}.min.js"; done
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run stamp && npm run csp
scripts.verify: npm ci && npm run build && npm run check:links && npm run check:ui && npm run check:csp && node --check sw.js && node --check assets/agent-a.min.js && node --check assets/events.min.js && node --check assets/brand-marquee.js && echo VERIFY-OK
